system.description: Starting at 6th level, when you deal psychic damage to a creature with a Genjutsu you cast they begin to suffer slight hallucinations, echoes of a different world made entirely of their nightmares. The next creature that targets the affected creature with an attack before the beginning of your next turn, gains a +1 bonus to their attack roll and Critical threat range.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
